name: partner-access-readiness-store-scope
executionConcern: partner identity refresh-session isolation, canonical Partner/Store readiness, authorized Store scope and post-onboarding field feedback
objective: Make Partner access/readiness/Store scope derive only from Identity plus canonical DSH Partner/Store truth, prove current refresh/session isolation, and govern the Partner post-onboarding field-rating flow without turning it into access truth.
truthOwner: Identity owns authentication/session/refresh/surface; DSH owns Partner/Store operational readiness/scope and provider-rating facts; WLT owns payout destination/financial prerequisite truth.
journeys: Partner login and exact session-surface gate

tasks.objective: Close Partner Identity refresh/session and Store-scope authorization end to end
tasks.currentProblem: The runtime gate remains correct at a high level, but current BB added refresh-rotation concurrency/session-outage behavior and old evidence does not prove concurrent refresh, replay, actor switch or stale Store state cannot cross Partner sessions.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Partner session creation/refresh/logout through Identity, SecureStore and DSH Store authorization; reproduce concurrent refresh/replay/outage/actor-switch cases; fix the first authoritative divergence and remove any stale local authorization/readiness fallback.
tasks.targetState: Only a currently authenticated `partner` session for `app-partner` with canonical DSH readiness and server-authorized Store scope can execute Partner operations; one refresh successor wins and stale/replayed/session-switched state cannot authorize or expose another Partner/Store.
tasks.action: Run Identity backend/session contracts and Partner runtime/DSH authorization tests first; correct Identity or DSH owner only where evidence fails; clear/rebind affected local/push state; rerun exact-candidate negative and counterpart readback checks.
mustNotChange: Do not create local Partner readiness/session truth.
Do not trust selected Store as authorization.
Do not bypass role/surface/readiness during outage/development.
Do not permit replay/concurrent refresh to create multiple valid successor sessions.
Do not move raw payout destination identifiers into DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong role/surface, stale/replayed session, missing/deactivated Partner or unauthorized Store fails closed.
Concurrent refresh has one governed successor and actor switch/restart cannot expose prior Partner state.
Every Store-scoped operation re-authorizes the Store server-side.
Partner/operator/client readiness/publication readbacks converge on committed state.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused authoritative-owner change while preserving session/migration/audit security; never restore permissive refresh or local Store authorization.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U001 access/session/Store-scope change set after reproduced failure and all linked checks pass.

tasks.objective: Close Partner device/push/restart recovery without device-local authority
tasks.currentProblem: SecureStore fingerprint and push registration are current runtime dependencies but do not by themselves prove logout/relogin/restart/actor change cannot retain stale Partner addressing/readback.
tasks.requiredChange: Exercise device/session/push lifecycle and repair only proven stale binding/cache/recovery defects while keeping Identity/DSH authorization authoritative.
tasks.targetState: No device fingerprint, push token or local Store/readback state survives an actor boundary as authorization or fabricated readiness.
tasks.action: Verify logout/relogin/restart/actor switch and transport outage; clear/rebind local/push state only where required; canonical state is re-read before protected presentation/action.
mustNotChange: Do not log tokens or sensitive device identifiers.
Do not use fingerprint/push as authorization.
Do not fabricate readiness when backend truth is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/relogin/restart/actor switch cannot retain another Partner's protected readback.
Push registration is actor/surface scoped and re-bound according to authenticated lifecycle.
Transport failure remains explicit and cannot grant access.
tasks.rollback: Revert only the focused runtime binding fix; never restore insecure persistence or authorization shortcuts.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep runtime recovery fixes inside U001 and rerun the complete session evidence set.

tasks.objective: Govern Partner post-onboarding field rating as canonical optional feedback, not access truth
tasks.currentProblem: PartnerFieldRatingGate is a current app-partner path missing from the old package. It overlays a dismissible rating prompt after onboarding/activation and currently suppresses prompt errors, but its server eligibility/relationship/duplicate semantics are not covered by Partner closure evidence.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace prompt/submit through provider-ratings API, DSH authorization/domain/persistence and onboarding relationship. Confirm Product/PRD optionality; repair cross-Partner/field relationship, duplicate/retry/readback or misleading local-completion behavior at the authoritative owner without making rating a Partner access gate.
tasks.targetState: Only the eligible authenticated Partner can submit the governed rating for the actual onboarding field relationship; completion is durable/duplicate-safe, dismissal is presentation-only, and prompt/API failure never changes Partner access/readiness.
tasks.action: Exercise eligible/ineligible/already-completed/wrong-Partner/wrong-field/duplicate/retry/fetch-failure cases; fix DSH owner or presentation mapping only where evidence fails; verify no independent Field-app product work is imported.
mustNotChange: Do not make a dismissible feedback modal an authorization/readiness source unless Product Truth is explicitly changed by the proper authority.
Do not let local dismissal mark server completion.
Do not allow cross-Partner or arbitrary field rating.
Do not broaden Field workforce/product scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Server prompt eligibility and submit authorization derive from the authenticated Partner and real onboarding relationship.
Already-completed/duplicate/cross-scope attempts are deterministic and cannot create duplicate rating truth.
Dismiss/fetch failure does not alter Partner access/readiness or fabricate completion.
Committed completion is read back canonically after submit/restart.
tasks.rollback: Revert focused rating-path correction while preserving existing Partner access and durable rating facts; never restore cross-scope or local-completion truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Keep provider-rating correction focused and separate from unrelated Field product changes.
